187 likes, 13 comments - namratasoni on October 20, 2026: "Delhi, are you ready? ✨💄

I’m coming to Nykaa Land on 24th October for an exclusive live makeup workshop , and I can’t wait to share my favourite professional makeup techniques, insider tips and tricks from my 27 years in Bollywood.

If you love makeup and want to learn how to create beautiful, flawless looks with a professional touch, this is your chance to learn with me, live and in person!

Come spend two hours with me and take your makeup skills to the next level. ❤️

📍 Nykaa Land, NSIC Exhibition Grounds, Okhla, New Delhi
📅 24th October 2026

Book your tickets now through the link and come meet me at Nykaa Land!

Can’t wait to see you there! ✨

#NykaaLand #NamrataSoni #MakeupMasterclass #DelhiBeauty #MakeupLovers".
